newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 was stable in late trading amid sluggish consumer demand, traders said.

They said offer prices were unchanged at 49.75 U.S. cents/lb for June shipment fob Palembang after overnight buying. One trader in Medan said a deal was also done overnight in the north Sumatran city at 50.00, but the quantity was low.

"There has been some sporadic buying in the market by buyers who are looking for cheap prices. Market sentiment remains poor in the absence of fresh factors," said one trader. Traders said buyers mostly came from the United States.
Traders said offer prices were unchanged at 50.00 fob Surabaya, at 49.75 fob Padang and at 49.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"Market direction has been very difficult to predict recently. For instance, supply is tight in Medan because of wintering but prices do not improve at all," said another trader.
Many traders have earlier predicted that offer prices could fall below 50.00 U.S. cents/lb because of the prolonged poor consumer demand.
